knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An unidentified service is treated as live. Mark, keep tools away and inform the supervisor.
The hierarchy of control starts with elimination and moves through substitution and separation before PPE.
Work near power lines is excluded. Stop, record and refer to a licence holder.

practicalCriteria: Given a mock garden site, the learner marks at least four hazards on a site hazard map within the assessor's set time, including one overhead and one buried or suspected service.
The learner draws a two-zone layout with a work zone and buffer zone and places a barrow access route.
The learner states at least two site-specific stop-work triggers and the action for each.
evidenceRequired: Annotated site hazard map signed by the assessor.
Assessor observation record of the stop-work discussion.
Record of any simulated trigger in a supervised role-play.
stopWorkCriteria: Cutting or digging near a supplied service marker during the assessment.
Approaching a simulated overhead line closer than the assessor's safe distance.
Continuing a simulated task after a stop-work trigger is announced.
